tasks.short: Inspect cut textile products against quality standards and specifications

steps.what: Read the product specifications and quality standards for the cutting job
Inspect cut textile products and judge conformance to the specification
Record the product inspection findings and conformance judgement

tasks.design: Configure job-linked specifications and a contextual inspection form in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The operator still inspects the fabric and records actual findings; the form removes repeated job details and report structure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct specification and repeating job details interrupt inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked documents and inspection fields can retain current job context.
tasks.still_hard: Texture, edge quality, pattern alignment and unusual defects require physical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognizes unacceptable fabric or cut quality that routine fields do not describe.
tasks.altitude: A shorter lookup and recording fragment; physical quality judgement is unchanged.

reach.role: inspector, tester, sorter, sampler, and weigher

evidence.claim: Native job-linked documents and contextual inspection forms can reduce navigation and repeated identifiers; no textile-defect detection or measured saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary includes specification lookup, actual inspection and the inspection record. It does not invent a release approval or automatic defect decision.

The existing quality or production team supplies job id, specification version and criteria through its normal work. The operator verifies applicability in s1; missing or conflicting criteria return to manual clarification.
The operator produces actual observations and judgement in s2 and captures job, sample, observation, time and result in s3. Capture remains counted; no ready-made defect code or pass flag is assumed.
Test native specification links and inspection forms before code. Savings concern repeated context and structure, not actual inspection, factual capture or same-system save.
research_questions: Does contextual recording reduce repeated fields after actual observations remain counted?

already_counted.description: Actual inspection-record capture and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain specification links and contextual form fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R93, gross7 minus2 upkeep gives net5. Range1-3 assumes real repeated context and lookup remain; physical inspection and actual findings retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record completed textile work and machine settings

steps.what: Identify the cutting job, machine and recording interval
Read completed-work counts and machine settings from the cutting equipment
Write the completed-work and settings values onto the production record
Record manual adjustments, rejects and reasons missing from machine data
Re-key the production record into the shift spreadsheet
Check the recorded work and settings against the actual job

tasks.design: Test native read-only capture from the {OTHER} cutting-machine controller into {OPS_SYSTEM}. It fills the production values record, the operator adds uncaptured facts, and the native report replaces actual re-keying into {SPREADSHEET}; each read and record write is a separate step.
tasks.previous_blocker: Machine values are copied onto a job card and then entered again in a shift log.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing machine interfaces and production-system connectors may already support the required values.
tasks.still_hard: A counter may not represent accepted pieces, and the job-machine match must be correct.
tasks.human_edge: The operator explains rejects and manual adjustments that the machine cannot infer.
tasks.altitude: Less copying and re-keying, with time retained for job matching and unexplained counts.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of production and operating workers
reach.task: Interpret completed-work counts with rejects and manual adjustments

evidence.claim: Lectra Valia Furniture provides production and maintenance dashboards, while Valia Fashion supports order-to-cut workflows and cutting-equipment dashboards; this supports native production-data investigation, not guaranteed compatibility or this labour estimate.
The controller-to-record mapping and paper-card plus spreadsheet baseline are unmeasured model-knowledge assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary includes job identification, reading values, production-record writing, operator explanations, actual second-system re-keying and checking. The baseline requires an existing paper-card and shift-log routine; already automated records earn no new saving.

The operator produces job id, machine id and interval in s1 at full time. The cutting controller produces counter, setting value, unit and timestamp during existing operation; connecting to those existing values does not require free human capture.
The operator captures actual rejects, adjustment and reason text in s4 with full time retained. Accepted count is not inferred from a gross machine counter without the operator's correction.

Missing interfaces, stale timestamps or an uncertain job match stop automatic recording and return to the current manual read-and-entry routine. s6 checks the actual record; no free discrepancy code is assumed.

Test native connectors and reports before custom code. This is read-only access to equipment, with internal record writes only; no machine command, external send or invented self-approval. s5 removes real re-keying, not a same-system save.
unknowns: Available controller interfaces and counter definitions
Whether the paper-card and second-log baseline exists
research_questions: Can native capture reproduce checked job counts without extra manual matching?
Does the report remove a real second entry while preserving operator explanations?

already_counted.description: Job context capture, uncaptured facts and record checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Check failed captures, maintain mappings and verify counters after machine changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R40, gross60 minus8 upkeep gives net52 for a genuine copy-and-rekey baseline. Range15-35 assumes only some machines and values support reliable native capture; operator context and explanations retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe the mechanical malfunction and establish the immediate machine condition
Write the mechanical-malfunction note with the observed symptoms
Notify the supervisor of the final malfunction facts
Clarify the malfunction and answer the supervisor's questions

tasks.design: Use a contextual malfunction-note form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to retain machine and job identifiers. The operator records actual symptoms, notifies the internal supervisor and answers questions; no automatic alarm or maintenance request is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: A short malfunction record repeats machine and job context.
tasks.enabler_now: Native contextual fields can shorten that written fragment.
tasks.still_hard: Symptoms may be ambiguous and the immediate condition needs physical observation.
tasks.human_edge: The operator describes what actually happened and responds to follow-up questions.
tasks.altitude: A small note-writing gain; notification and supervisor contact remain human.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of production and operating workers
reach.task: Clarify symptoms before arranging mechanical support

evidence.claim: A contextual native malfunction form can reduce repeated machine identifiers while leaving symptom capture and internal notification human; the estimate is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes observation, a short actual malfunction note, notification and clarification. Urgent safety communication is not delayed for form completion; its effort stays human.
The operator produces symptom, machine id, job id, observation time and immediate condition in s1 and s2. Capture remains counted, and no ready-made fault or severity code is assumed.
Missing context returns to manual description. The native form retains stable identifiers only; no automatic diagnosis or supervisor alert is hidden.
Test existing native forms first. The note save has no saving or self-gate; the actual notification is internal and checks the facts it conveys.
unknowns: Whether a written note is currently part of notification
research_questions: Can repeated identifiers be removed without shortening actual symptom capture?

already_counted.description: Actual note capture and notification checks remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact observed machine, job, symptoms and immediate condition checked before notifying the intended supervisor in s3; changes require a fresh factual check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R96, gross4 minus1 upkeep gives net3. Range0-1 assumes an actual note with repeated identifiers; verbal-only notification receives no form-writing gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with coworkers about orders, processes and problems

steps.what: Read the order and process information relevant to the coworker discussion
Confer with coworkers to clarify orders, processes or problems
Record the clarified order or process information in the job notes

tasks.design: Configure the {OPS_SYSTEM} job view with linked process instructions and contextual job notes. The operator still confers with coworkers and captures the actual clarification, while navigation and repeated job identifiers become shorter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Looking up order context and arranging job notes interrupts coworker discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job-linked instructions and notes can reduce those fragments.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected fabric or process issues require the coworkers' experience.
tasks.human_edge: The operator asks the right follow-up questions and understands local practice.
tasks.altitude: Coworker contact stays human; selected lookup and note work becomes shorter.

evidence.claim: Native linked job views and contextual notes can reduce navigation and repeated identifiers without replacing coworker clarification; the estimate is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes relevant lookup, the discussion and actual job-note writing. No conversation or internal note is classified as an external action.

The existing order owner supplies job id and order version, and the process owner supplies instruction version through normal work. The operator checks them in s1; no newly structured coworker answer is demanded.

Coworkers provide the clarification in the unchanged conversation, and the operator captures job id, issue, clarification and source person in s3. Capture time remains counted; no transcript or answer label is assumed.

Missing or conflicting instructions return to manual clarification. Test native linked views and contextual notes first. No automatic send, task assignment or record commitment is hidden; internal note saves earn no saving or self-approval.
unknowns: Existing instruction links and job-note routine
Whether repeated identifiers take measurable time
research_questions: Does the native job view reduce lookup and repeated note context after all clarification writing remains counted?

already_counted.description: Coworker discussion and actual job-note capture remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain instruction links and note fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R93, gross7 minus2 upkeep gives net5. Range1-3 assumes real repeated lookup and identifiers remain; conversation and actual clarification capture retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Textile inspection, machine judgement and coworker contact remain human; native forms and verified machine data can shorten selected clerical work.
reach: Explain machine counts and exceptions to production supervisors
skills_to_grow: Distinguish gross counters from accepted output
role.ambitious_version: An operator with less copying and repeated record structure, and clearer evidence for production and quality decisions.
